propositions: The compaction sweep executes one git log --full-history walk per ticket inside the store write lock, causing minutes-long stalls holding all writers; the walk should be hoisted outside the lock and amortized across all tickets using a single position-keyed map

The sweep never re-yields mid-run to check for waiting writers, so a sweep that began on a quiet store blocks any writer arriving after it starts; the per-ticket loop must re-probe write_lock_is_busy between tickets

The _commit_backfill function stages with unscoped git add -A, allowing concurrent writers' in-flight event files to be swept into the compaction commit; staging must be scoped to only the folded paths

The _build_authorship_ledger function rebuilds per-ticket commit maps inside the lock; it should accept an optional prebuilt position-keyed map built once per sweep outside the lock, while remaining optional for the rebuild path in compact_rebuild.py
A prebuilt map must be position-keyed not path-keyed to match the lookups in _build_authorship_ledger; a path-keyed map would silently miss every lookup and fall back to per-event walks
A ticket whose events change between prep and the locked re-check must be skipped cleanly without writing a SNAPSHOT or retiring sources, leaving events live for the next pass
